narration: Your agent showed you the mortgage. They showed you property taxes. But they never once showed you this number.
visual: Dark background. House SVG springs into frame — triangle roof, rectangle body, windows, door. Price tag badge fades in: $450,000 LISTING PRICE. HOA badge springs in below: +$330/MO — NOT IN THE LISTING.

narration: HOA fees average $330 a month nationwide. And they're not optional — miss payments and the HOA can literally foreclose on your home.
visual: Light background. SVG invoice labeled HOA INVOICE. Dollar counter animates from $0 to $330. Red warning badge slides up: MISS PAYMENTS? THEY CAN FORECLOSE.

narration: Over a 30-year mortgage, that $330 a month adds up to $118,800 in fees. And that's before a single special assessment even hits.
visual: Dark background. Red bar grows vertically as counter animates from $0 to $118,800. 30 YEARS label at base. BEFORE SPECIAL ASSESSMENTS note fades in below.

narration: Special assessments — surprise bills for shared repairs — average $2,300 each. Most communities levy two or three of them every decade.
visual: Light background. Envelope SVG flap opens, letter slides out: SPECIAL ASSESSMENT $2,300. Large $2,300 springs in below. Red badge: 2–3 TIMES EVERY DECADE.

narration: Here's the real gut punch. If you invested that $330 a month at seven percent instead, after thirty years you'd have $404,000.
visual: Dark background. Two bars side by side. Left red bar: HOA FEES PAID $118,800. Right green bar grows taller with counter to $404,000. $404,000 DIFFERENCE badge in green.

narration: Before you sign anything, demand five years of HOA meeting minutes and the reserve fund balance. That one question could save you everything.
visual: Light background. Person silhouette with clipboard. Checklist of three items springs in: 5 YEARS HOA MINUTES, RESERVE FUND BALANCE, SPECIAL ASSESSMENT HISTORY. Red CTA badge: ONE QUESTION. SAVE EVERYTHING.
